P01.rationale: There are no human portraits on this page; it consists entirely of text and process diagrams.

P05.rationale: The page contains a methodology breakdown rather than case studies with client portraits.

P07.rationale: There is no social-proof apparatus such as logos or testimonials present on this page.

P10.rationale: No oversized decorative typographic elements are used; the typography is strictly functional and editorial.

P11.rationale: The '30-50%' statistic in the bottom right serves as a real data visualization bound to specific numbers.

P12.rationale: The layout is dense and fills the sheet with content blocks, though it lacks the visual variety of a full magazine spread.

P13.rationale: The background is a flat, solid off-white color without any intentional texture or atmosphere.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page to evaluate for treatment.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockups are shown in the layout.

N07.rationale: The imagery is composed entirely of text and diagrams rather than generic stock photos.

N08.rationale: There is a small amount of dead whitespace at the bottom right corner below the dark blue box.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on busy photos; it is contained within clean boxes or placed over flat backgrounds.
